description: Use when an agent must price an LLM call or pick the cheapest model. Input: model (up to 5, comma list) plus optional input_tokens, output_tokens, requests; or no model plus mode, provider, min_context, capabilities (vision, function_calling...). Output: JSON USD per 1M input/output tokens, cached/batch prices, context window, provider, capabilities, cost estimate or cheapest ranking, as_of + source commit. Example: ?model=gpt-4o&input_tokens=12000&output_tokens=800 Price: $0.004 USDC via x402.

capabilities.description: Comma-separated required capabilities: vision, function_calling, reasoning, prompt_caching, response_schema, pdf_input, audio_input, audio_output, web_search, computer_use, video_input

include_deprecated.description: Include models past their deprecation date in the cheapest search (default false)

input_tokens.description: Input (prompt) tokens per request, for the cost estimate and ranking

limit.description: Max rows per model or in the ranking (default 10)

mode.description: Model type for the cheapest search (default chat; chat includes responses-API models). Ignored when model is given

model.description: Model name(s), up to 5 comma-separated (gpt-4o, claude-sonnet-4-5, gemini/gemini-2.5-flash). Also lists the same model at other providers. Omit to rank the cheapest models. Unknown → 400 with suggestions (not charged)

provider.description: LiteLLM provider id filter: openai, anthropic, gemini, vertex_ai, bedrock, azure, groq, deepseek, mistral...

requests.description: Number of requests to multiply the estimate by (default 1)

name: llm_model_prices
title: LLM model price lookup, token cost calculator and cheapest-model finder
